rule.name: ParameterMutation
rule.message: This changes the collection, map or array the caller passed in. Build and return a new one (List.copyOf, a stream, new ArrayList<>(items) filled and returned), or copy the parameter first and change the copy.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $mutators := ('add', 'addAll', 'addFirst', 'addLast', 'remove', 'removeAll', 'removeIf', 'removeFirst', 'removeLast', 'retainAll', 'clear', 'put', 'putAll', 'putIfAbsent', 'merge', 'compute', 'computeIfAbsent', 'computeIfPresent', 'replaceAll', 'sort', 'set', 'push', 'pop', 'poll', 'offer'), $statics := ('sort', 'parallelSort', 'fill', 'setAll', 'shuffle', 'reverse', 'swap', 'rotate', 'replaceAll', 'addAll'), $copies := ('copyOf', 'copyOfRange', 'clone', 'collect', 'toList', 'toArray', 'toSet', 'toMap'), $shared := ('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue', 'java.util.concurrent.BlockingDeque', 'java.util.concurrent.TransferQueue', 'java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap', 'java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue', 'java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque', 'java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList', 'java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet', 'java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListSet') return ( //MethodCall[@MethodName = $mutators] /*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess[*[1][self::ThisExpression]]] [pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')] | //MethodCall[*[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType[@SimpleName = ('Arrays', 'Collections')]]] [@MethodName = $statics]/ArgumentList/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //AssignmentExpression/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //AssignmentExpression/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //AssignmentExpression/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')]/ArrayAccess/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')]/ArrayAccess/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::VariableAccess] )[let $name := @Name, $at := ., $method := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1], $params := $method/FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name return exists($method) and not($method[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private'] or $method/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Override']) and not($method/ancestor::*[self::AnonymousClassDeclaration or self::LocalClassStatement or self::ClassDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private']]) and ((self::VariableAccess and $name = $params) or exists($method//VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $name][*[2][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $params]]]) or exists($method//AssignmentExpression[@Operator = '='] [*[1][self::FieldAccess or self::VariableAccess][@Name = $name]]
